description: Estimate the reclaimable withholding tax for a whole dividend history in one call: send either a broker export as csv_text with its broker id, or a list of payments (ISIN, payment_date YYYY-MM-DD, gross_amount, currency, optional withheld_amount), max 500. Returns each payment with its source country, treaty rate, reclaimable amount in the residence currency, form and deadline, plus totals per source country. A payment whose source country cannot be resolved is returned as unresolved with no amount; withheld_is_estimated marks a withholding figure estimated from the statutory rate.

withheld_amount.description: Tax withheld at source; omit if unknown and it is estimated
withheld_amount.title: Withheld Amount

broker.description: One of: avanza, bux, degiro, etoro, freetrade, ibkr, ibkr_flex, nordnet, rabobank, revolut, saxo, schwab, swissquote, trade_republic, trading212, xtb, or generic (needs column_map)
broker.title: Broker

column_map.description: generic only: target field -> CSV column (asset_name, payment_date, gross_amount, ...)
column_map.title: Column Map
